title: The Laboratory Cyrus Poonawalla Put in a Corner of the Stud Farm
conflicts: Starting capital: Poonawalla (BioSpectrum 2004), Coomi Kapoor and The Asian Age give about Rs 5 lakh; Asterisk gives Rs 99,000 ($12,000) and Bloomberg/Quartz say $12,000 from selling horses plus a loan from his father. Used the founder's figure. Origin of the idea: popular accounts credit Poonawalla's own insight; his own account and Kapoor credit the farm vet Dr Balakrishnan; followed them. Age at founding (22 v about 25) left out.
notes: Founder's own account from a 2004 BioSpectrum interview; Coomi Kapoor's 2021 book extract (Open Magazine) supplies the wedding-day foundation stone, Morarji Desai's racing ban and the mules. Quartz (403) and Bloomberg not cited.
